| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Delta** `delta` | 5 | 1 to 50 levels | The range of gray levels over which the area of a region is compared. OpenCV uses 5. |
| **Smallest area** `minArea` | 60 | 1 to 100000 px | Smaller regions are dropped. OpenCV uses 60. |
| **Largest area** `maxArea` | 14400 | 10 to 1e+06 px | Larger regions are dropped. OpenCV uses 14400. If it is below the smallest area, the smallest is used. |
| **Most variation** `maxVariation` | 0.25 | 0.01 to 1 | The largest relative change of the area a stable region may have. OpenCV uses 0.25. |
| **Least diversity** `minDiversity` | 0.2 | 0 to 1 | Of nested regions whose areas differ by less than this share, only one stays. OpenCV uses 0.2. |
